lib/org-features.ts: feature-switch definitions: roofing names shown in Settings -> Features, which itself is profile-labelled

lib/print-kit.ts: original company's print kit brand, returned only when original_brand is set
lib/crm-email-from.ts: original company's From alias on the unfenced shared app only (hardcode ratchet tracks it)
app/page.tsx: public product marketing page for the ARX CRM product, not company screens
app/privacy/page.tsx: product privacy policy, not a company screen
app/terms/page.tsx: product terms of service, not a company screen
components/AuthShell.tsx: login shell fallback shown only when no company resolves from the host (the original company's login)
app/admin/door-drop/: door-drop print kit: original company only (doorDropAvailable: roofing profile + original_brand)
lib/contracts/terms.ts: original company's contract wording; per-company contract templates are multi-company slice 2b (legal review pending)

app/api/public/estimate/: public roof instant-estimate: roofing website feature
lib/adjuster-meeting-alert.ts: insurance adjuster alerts: insurance feature switch
lib/ai/insurance-claim-benchmarks.ts: insurance benchmarks: insurance feature switch (ARX data)
